notes.title: Diamond Update 2.0 - Who Wants Diamonds?
notes.content:
DIAMONDS ARE FLOODING THE MARKET

The drop bug is fixed and now you can get all the Diamonds you want, a lot of you will have diamonds in your inventory that you have earned before this update.

We also added a Diamond Burst effect, when you see it you will know a diamond is soon coming your way and you’re 1 step closer to becoming the Diamond KING.

Since the last update, we hit 300 unique players we thank you all for your support and dedication.

GET THOSE DIAMONDS!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1

Thanks for the heads up everybody! ːsteamhappyː

LET'S GET THOSE DIAMONDS!!!
